Adam.title: Adam
Adam.question: Will humanity receive creation as a gift and accept the limits of trust?

chapters.title: Formed from Dust
chapters.game: Gather the garden’s elements in creation order.

chapters.title: The Garden
chapters.game: Tend the garden by planting seeds and pulling weeds before they spread.

chapters.title: Together
chapters.game: Build a shared shelter and tend one plot together.

chapters.title: The Boundary
chapters.game: Navigate abundance while leaving one tree untouched.

chapters.title: The Choice
chapters.game: Spot the serpent’s half-truths in a dialogue puzzle.

chapters.title: Hiding
chapters.game: Follow footprints and admit what happened.

chapters.title: East of Eden
chapters.game: Pack seeds and begin cultivation outside the garden.

chapters.title: Cain and Abel
chapters.game: Prepare offerings with care, then cool Cain’s anger.

chapters.title: The Field
chapters.game: Witness consequence and mark a refuge path.

chapters.title: A New Line
chapters.game: Plant a family tree from Seth onward.
